g.text: Hierarchical roofline, Orin vs Thor: π0.5's phases sit far below every tensor ceiling — the model is bandwidth-bound, not TOPS-bound

Log–log. Horizontal lines = compute ceilings (measured, A.2–A.4). Sloped lines = memory roofs (slope = measured bandwidth, A.5–A.6). Datasheet peaks dashed grey. Dots = real workload phases at their arithmetic intensity.
Arithmetic intensity (FLOP per byte) — log scale

g.text: — green = Thor measured ceiling · blue = Orin measured ceiling
— dashed coloured = Orin counterpart of a Thor roof
— red/black dot = measured π0.5 phase / WBC at its AI
— sloped line = memory roof (slope = measured bandwidth)
Axes approximate (hand-placed on log grid); values are exact per sources.

Sources (values from constants.json / notes, not retyped): [A.2] cuda_fp32/fp16/int8_ceiling · [A.3] tensor_classic_* and tensor_tcgen05_* · [A.4] nvfp4_dense_ceiling · [A.5] l1_read_aggregate · [A.6] dram_bandwidth_read_measured, l2_resident_read_bandwidth · [C.1] π0.5 AI (prefill 731, action 10) and sustained ~35 TFLOP/s · [L4]/[B.8] WBC AI≈0.4.
